rules.rationale: The fee-vector example, runtime read models, bounded DNF evaluator, Governance ballot sums, and runtime Actor topology integrity checks iterate only type-bounded, explicit retention-limited, or fixed genesis values. Governance sums consume MaxWinningVoteAccountsPerCall-bounded ballots. Oracle storage iteration is confined to try-state and bounded by MaxFeeds/MaxFeedsPerProducer registries; it never runs in consensus execution.
rules.expiry: Remove a path if its input loses an explicit bound or its iteration moves into consensus execution.

semantic counter bound is precluded by admission
task failure cannot complete a cycle
attempt admission excludes an exhausted failure counter
admitted cursor-local retry counter remains below its u32 bound
admitted mutable RetryLater plan has a valid unresolved cursor

rules.rationale: These exact execution assertions are mechanically precluded by the canonical actor loader, admission bounds, exhaustive StepOutcome control mapping, integrity checks, or transactional finalization; the four compact fit messages belong to the file-local test module. Any differently worded site is unowned and fails the full-tree audit.
rules.expiry: Replace an entry when its assertion becomes typed failure or when its preclusion owner changes.
